headline: Quarterly results show strong revenue growth for mid‑caps while top‑tier firms see modest expansion.
summary: TCS posted 15% YoY revenue growth and a 24% operating margin. Coforge delivered the fastest top‑line expansion at 53.6% YoY and raised its EBIT margin guidance. Infosys trimmed FY27 revenue guidance to 1‑2% and reported only 1.5% YoY growth. AI revenue is becoming a notable driver, especially for HCLTech and LTM.

themes.title: AI‑driven growth
themes.detail: Companies such as HCLTech, LTM and Wipro highlighted AI‑related revenue jumps and large‑deal wins.

themes.title: Guidance tightening
themes.detail: Infosys cut its FY27 revenue outlook, reflecting a cautious view of the market.

leaders.why: 53.6% YoY revenue growth and raised FY27 EBIT margin guidance to 16%.
15.6% YoY revenue growth and solid operating margin.

laggards.why: Revenue growth slowed to 1.5% YoY and guidance was cut.
Profit fell 25% YoY despite revenue growth.
